content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected on service runtime-canary (us-east-1) - 5xx spike from 01:23 UTC. Auto-rollback check failed. Paging @ryan_oncall.

ryan_oncall: on it. taking lead. assigning mitigation steps.

mike: seeing ~12% customer-facing 500s on the /generate endpoint. traffic mix shows ~8% routed to v2-canary unexpectedly.

jonah: autoscaler/rollback didn't trigger? logs show rollout controller saw errors but didn't match canary label.

ryan_oncall: suspect routing label mismatch. killing canary traffic via feature flag now.

ryan_oncall: run:
```
rosterctl feature-toggle set routing.canary_v2 false --env production
```

alex_prod: executed feature-toggle. output: "OK - routing.canary_v2=false" :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: DeployBot queued manual rollback job (job id rb-349123) for v2-canary -> v1. Will start in 30s unless aborted.

mike: start draining current canary pods too to stop new sessions: `kubectl drain -l app=runtime,canary=true --ignore-daemonsets`

emily: draining now. 3 pods marked Terminating. traffic to canary dropped from 8% -> 0.6% in 40s.

jonah: confirmed rollback job failed initially due to selector mismatch; requeued with corrected selector (canary=true)

alex_prod: requeued rollback succeeded. rollout reverted to v1 across us-east-1. logs show <0.5% 5xx now.

ryan_oncall: running smoke test against /health and /generate for a sample prompt.

mike: smoke curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq '.status'
```

jonah: result: "ok" and latency ~120ms. no errors in the last 2m.

emily: customer-impact: affected sessions ~420 for last 15m, mainly enterprise eu-west-1 customers on long-context workloads. AM alerted support.

mike: action items: 1) postmortem owner jonah+emily 2) verify rollout gating rules 3) add integration test for label mismatches 4) update runbook steps for feature-toggle fallback

ryan_oncall: creating INC ticket INC-2026-3491 and assigning to @jonah @emily. monitor 30m then hand to ENG for postmortem.

alex_prod: remind to tag the deploy with `reverted=349123` and add commit link.

jonah: added notes to the ticket and linked deploy hash. starting RCA draft.

emily: will coordinate customer comms. support team pinged. :fire_engine:

ryan_oncall: closing the live mitigation. keeping channel open for 30m monitoring. good work everyone. :thumbsup:
